migration_rules.rule: P1 may begin beside BrainC FastAPI using PV-DLAM schemas and receipts, but must expose an explicit adapter boundary so later PhiOS integration does not require rewriting canonical memory identities.

Existing Vessie browser memory, BrainC conversation memory, PhiOS governed memory, NBG experimental memory, and related lattice stores are donor/source systems until explicitly imported through a versioned migration manifest.
An import preserves source system, source record identity when available, epistemic origin, lineage, restrictions, and import receipt. Import does not promote truth or authority.
During migration there may be multiple readable legacy sources, but only one writable PV-DLAM canonical target per namespace/frontier.
Infinite Porch may later carry scoped sync only after adapter/security qualification; the memory service remains responsible for admission and current authority checks.
